scope: One U-Boot RAM boot with CPU1 released during kernel startup

result.cpu: Serial reported two CPUs activated at 0.285 seconds; RAM reported online=0-1 and a CPU1-pinned read succeeded
result.activity: Over 25 seconds CPU1 scheduler, function-call and timer-broadcast counts advanced; cpu1 user time rose 169 to 198 ticks
result.watchdog: Mainline nowayout WDT2 fed at 120-second timeout; pings advanced from 9 to 14
result.storage: eMMC stayed read-only and unmounted; factory p8 restored before RAM userspace
result.qt: Started once and remained PID 141; no display cycles or Qt restarts requested
result.recovery: Requested reboot returned stock Linux 3.4.113+ and Phoenix after 36.7 seconds; exact factory p8 and approved ADC postflight passed

limits: One short run does not establish long-duration dual-core stability or thermal behavior under load.
U-Boot stops WDT2 and this image starts it at driver probe, leaving a pre-probe hang without proven automatic recovery.
CPU frequency, voltage, suspend and production power policy remain unqualified.
The ram104 profile remains the qualified default pending broader ram110 peripheral and network regression.
